pr.body:
The frontend Files screen needs a public contract for document creation, revision, inspection and verified download. This adds @capiro/meri-contracts 0.1.2 with document-application and document-application/schema exports covering DOCX/TXT/XLSX, and integrates independently reviewed application admission and canonical 125-character filename handling.

ACCEPT_SOURCE / runtime HOLD. Frozen head 70516e5c9681917ce493bbc50e3023494f2e1209, tree 877aba389e06ea23671156c9dc062aa6ff36b284. Stacks PR52; no merge or deployment. Office recalculation/layout continuation is independent.

Browser API: receiveDocumentRequest(route, Uint8Array), await receiveDocumentResponse(route,status,Uint8Array,admittedRequest), await receiveDocumentDownload(Response,admittedVersion,options). The download result is {version,bytes}, compatible with Blob. Receipt provenance is integrity only, never authorization; authenticated transport must prevent redirects and bound JSON bodies.

Validation: root 71 public tests plus three generator checks/strict TypeScript; 58 independent actual-format/browser controls; 102 application tests. Independent isolated offline package installation and Blob types pass. Redirect, maximum-filename and typing counterexamples plus setup failures are preserved. Existing public0.1/private0.2 schemas, prior exports/generated bytes, old tests, migrations and catalog remain unchanged. 139 capabilities remain 96 selected/43 deferred; all 97 operations stay unimplemented, null handlers, pending, zero retries.

Package artifact: docs/qualification/candidates/document-contract-20261013/integration/capiro-meri-contracts-0.1.2.tgz (228048 bytes; SHA256 8a3f6c95935c368da5c01d87c599c5d13b9b62a21bc6924e7ad0b723bd5e91fa). No npm publication. 165 role manifest members and 32 integration members verified; seven owned groups absent and owned dependency/cache resources removed.

Report: docs/coordination/reports/CODEX-DOCUMENT-CONTRACT-INTEGRATION-20261013.md. No frontend changes, model/provider calls, native/private data, cloud changes or spend. G1 remains OPEN.

# Typed document application

`createDocumentApplication` in `index.mjs` is an inert Fetch boundary. It returns `{handle(Request)}` and owns no pool, session registry, listener, executor, storage or shutdown operation. The caller retains those resources. `enabled` defaults to `false`; this does not alter the canonical catalog's null handlers or runtime qualification.

```js
const app = createDocumentApplication({
  sessions: {authenticateSession, readCurrentState},
  selectedClientId, artifactOptions, credential, now,
  limits: {maxRequestMs: 15000, maxRequestBytes: 131072, maxResponseBytes: 1048576},
  enabled: true,
});
```

`artifactOptions` is the existing `createPostgresArtifactService` configuration, with the canonical `artifactValidators` object, the **same** `now` function, and the exact `create_word` or `create_excel` catalog descriptor projection `{operation,requiredGrants,sourceRequirements}`. Its prebound context, producer identity, immutable allocation and original expiry remain unchanged between deliveries. The caller performs canonical grant binding separately. The configured `credential` is the trusted artifact capability; it is never obtained from the HTTP request. The HTTP Bearer is a separately issued opaque action session. Existing `/api/action-followthrough/session` issuance can be mounted alongside this app on the same trusted host, as shown by the root-owned `local/mount.mjs`. No browser-provided identity, grant, scope, asset or evidence is admitted.

All four routes are POST with JSON and `Authorization: Bearer <opaque session>`:

| Route | Exact body | Success |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/api/documents/create` | `{deliveryId,request}` | `{version,inspection,execution}` |
| `/api/documents/revise` | `{deliveryId,baseVersionId,request}` | `{version,inspection,execution}` |
| `/api/documents/inspect` | `{versionId}` | `{version,inspection}` |
| `/api/documents/download` | `{versionId}` | Exact verified bytes with attachment filename and MIME |

Trusted configuration binds exactly one of those operations; request bodies cannot select another authority. `request` for `create_word` is the canonical typed `WordRequest` with `operation:'create_word'` and `format:'docx'` or `'txt'`. For DOCX, text uses blocks such as `{kind:'paragraph',runs:[{text:'Draft text'}]}`. TXT uses `{content:{text:'Draft text'}}`. Titles, tables, runs and supported chart/image references follow existing artifact contracts. With the exact `create_excel` descriptor, `request` is the canonical typed `ExcelRequest`: `{operation:'create_excel',format:'xlsx',title,content:{sheets:[{name,rows}]}}`. Cells distinguish literal `{value}` from `{formula}`; sheets, typed values, styles and charts follow the existing `Workbook` schema and validators. The application reuses the existing XlsxWriter creation and openpyxl typed-cell revision owners. A Word-bound app refuses Excel requests/results and an Excel-bound app refuses Word requests/results, including inspect/download. PDF, PowerPoint and general analysis are not admitted by this application. No natural-language model loop, approval choice or new renderer is introduced. Revision is a new full typed replacement based on the exact immutable prior version; it is not an in-place patch. Existing service verification preserves the original bytes and parent relationship.

A session fresh check precedes execution, every configured artifact/capability authorization boundary, and release. Current full binding, ordered scopes and selected client must equal the configured context. All session/authority cutoffs shorten one request lifetime; the original artifact context is not rewritten, so repeat delivery identity is stable. Older versions are read under current authority without changing their original version provenance. Reads use the existing artifact service and cannot call the canonical budget reservation/settlement path.

Responses have `Cache-Control: no-store` and `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`; no CORS permission is added. Downloads retain the canonical ASCII filename and MIME, and verify length/hash again before release. Borrowed port rejections are converted to inert content-free errors before passing into canonical owners; Proxy and accessor properties are not evaluated. Errors contain only `{error:{code,outcome}}`, never provider messages, credentials or draft content. Malformed route/body/media is refused before effects; session denial is 403, disabled application 503, timeout 408, cancellation 499, and other owner failures 502. Shared body size failures retain 413. A started write with uncertain completion is `UNKNOWN`; a returned result rejected at release is `RESULT_NOT_RELEASED`; unsuccessful reads are `READ_UNAVAILABLE`. These are conservative dispositions, not rollback or physical-cancellation proofs.

The same delivery is not regenerated. This boundary performs no automatic retry, refund, recovery mutation or fresh delivery allocation. Canonical historical reconciliation remains the artifact PostgreSQL owner's responsibility. Local structural inspection and actual DOCX/XLSX bytes do not establish native Office rendering, visual quality, production identity, physical sandbox isolation or real database qualification.

Workbook formulas are editable but generated formula caches remain unverified. Native-opened/rendered/recalculated flags come from the existing canonical inspection; this HTTP layer does not upgrade them. Root-owned local verification may render separate copies; it does not overwrite either retained version or assert production renderer qualification. The fixture operation option defaults to create_word, preserving the existing Word flow.

# Public document application source acceptance

ACCEPT_SOURCE; runtime HOLD. Parent-requested public `@capiro/meri-contracts`0.1.2 adds `./document-application` and `./document-application/schema` without changing frozen public0.1, private0.2, older exports or generated bytes. The exact source accepted independently is e91143dafe2da71546fdfb3b0152807032f4e9b8; application admission/125-character filename source16a4f883962bd72f9421949df95709f65b286555. This separate draft stacks PR52 4699fdea910ba25c809725630443198c8ae189e4; Office recalculation/layout work is a separate continuation.

Browser API: synchronous `receiveDocumentRequest(route, Uint8Array)`; async `receiveDocumentResponse(route,status,Uint8Array,admittedRequest)`; async `receiveDocumentDownload(Response,admittedVersion,options?)` returning `{version,bytes}`. Routes create/revise/inspect/download use exactly the existing request envelopes. Covers DOCX/TXT/XLSX only. Types support browser Blob construction. Strict closed shape/UTF8 bounds, version/request correlation and native-stream length/hash/header/redirect checks retain uncertainty. Local provenance branding is integrity, never authority. Consumers must use authenticated transport with redirect:error and bounded JSON acquisition. No list/search/upload/delete endpoint was added.

Canonical artifact definitions, immutable artifact service and existing app remain owners. A cohesive schema projection, byte boundary, JSON receiver and binary receiver compose the new export. The application now admits the exact configured Word or Excel canonical operation and format family. Cross-family requests/readbacks refuse. Source enabled defaults and all97 catalog handlers stay unavailable. The filename repair admits canonical125-byte ASCII names; forged126-character names refuse.

Root replay:71 public tests plus all3 generator checks/strict types;58 independent actual DOCX/TXT/XLSX receipt/download/browser controls;102 application controls including original Word tests and31 independent workbook controls. Review also proves isolated offline installation and strict Blob types. Root tar: 228048 bytes, SHA256 `8a3f6c95935c368da5c01d87c599c5d13b9b62a21bc6924e7ad0b723bd5e91fa`;19 public package files, no private implementation. No npm publication.

Audit:11,556 original entries retained;11,548 unchanged; eight changed original paths are explicit.21 source members match accepted author pins;165 role manifest members match. All original tests, public generated bytes, private schemas, migrations and catalog are unchanged.139 original capabilities remain96 mapped selected/43 deferred;97 unimplemented operations retain null handlers/pending qualification/zero retries. Reviewed application split keeps historical33 checks:31 application cases here, exact two CLI assertions preserved separately for the root workbook renderer continuation.

Original filename release and followed-redirect failures, Blob type failure, author/reviewer setup failures and every root setup failure are retained. The root setup corrections required no source changes. Seven captured groups freshly absent; owned dependency copies/links/npm cache removed, donors preserved. No private/customer data, model/provider call, cloud/native deployment, resource/security/database change or spend.

G0 accepted; G1 OPEN; G2-G7 unentered. Native runner identity/durability/sandbox/egress/teardown and real source access remain runtime gates. This contract and local generation evidence do not establish live Clerk, actual database/RLS, rendered Office equivalence or deployment readiness. PR53 native preservation retry exposed independent structural limits now under a separate urgent repair. No approval-semantics decision is made here.
